The timer, where you need it.

Don’t Break Fast keeps the essentials close and leaves everything else out.

  1. 01

    Weekly Rhythm

    This week on seven 24-hour lines, one for each day, including overnight fasts and time past your goal. It reads the history you already have.

  2. 02

    At a glance

    The timer draws your fast on a 24-hour day, and the same view follows you to widgets, the Lock Screen, Live Activity and Dynamic Island, with a Weekly Rhythm widget for the whole week.

  3. 03

    Private by design

    Your fasting history and settings stay on your device. There is no account, analytics, advertising or tracking.
